There you go. If you have any more you want looked at, just let me know.
I've gotten the drop on Ezra. I should take her shard and look for clues about why she was here at Fort Pale Pass to begin with.
I should see what else of interest Ezra has or bide my time and return her to Argus
I've gotten another shard off Ezra. I'll have to decide what to do about her. I can either return to Argus and risk her discovering the missing items, or do something drastic
I should see what else of interest Ezra has or bide my time and return her to Argus
I should see what else of interest Ezra has
I should see what else of interest Ezra has
I located Ezra who is very paranoid that I'm an assassin for some reason. She's reluctantly agreed to follow me, but insists on finding some item of importance in the dungeon beneath Fort Pale Pass.
I have found an ancient shield of some kind. Auryen may know more about it. I should track down the rest of the amulet pieces using Argus' journal first however.
I've parted ways with Ezra, sending her to find Argus on her own while tend to other tasks. I may be able to locate all of what they are seeking on my own.
I've found the remains of Ulgarg who met his untimely end in a violent way inside some nordic cave. There seems to be something odd glowing from his gut.

It seems that Ulgarg, in a moment of despiration, swallowed his fragment of the shard to keep it from the enemy. Fortunately it seems to have worked. Luckily the shard began to glow as I approached due to the presence of the other shards. I should head back to Argus.
I managed to recover the setting for the Amulet of Kings. I've managed to gather all the missing fragments and should return to Argus to see what the next plan is.

Argus and Ezra have double crossed me and paid the price for it. Apparently they were mercenaries hired to finish a job the Morag Tong were supposed to do. I should take back the shards, setting and ancient shield.

Auryen identified the ancient shield I found in Fort Pale Pass as the shield of Reman Cyrodiil, and he indicated that the shield resonates with the shards of the amulet. He's told me to return in a day or two so he can research the details.
Auryen should have had time to research the details surrounding the Amulet of Kings and the Shield. I should check back with him.
I have obtained the helm of Tiber Septim but feel as though the dark power binding me here still has hold over me. I should continue to investigate the source.
I've defeated Zurin Arctus, the Underking, though the power binding me here seems to remain. Perhaps he has some clue on him.

I've found a very unique and interesting ring which I should show Auryen, but no other major clues as to why I am still bound here. Perhaps his dark influence has corrupted this place and I need to exit the fortress before the Waystone can be removed.
I've destroted Ysmir Wulfharth and obtained his boots. I need to get the Lord's Mail before I head back to Sancre Tor. I must have it stashed somewhere.
Sets up thane rewards and levels up weapons
Sets up regular start and initialises some elements of the mod
adds luca pick axe to mining tools list
Kegbreaker has been drawn, alias will fill to select random tavern.
Kegbreaker removed, recover from effect and stop quest.
Auryen brought the Spear of the Snow Prince along on the excavation. As a probable devout follower of Trinimac, his spear may be able to open the way into the temple.
We attempted to overtake and fight Tulrin Deathweaver and his Falmer clan, but he proved to be as formidable as we feared. After overtaking his followers, he fled.
Legacy of the Dragonborn NPC dialogue

Marassi has the idea to establish a number of field stations across Skyrim to act as safehouses and supply stops for explorers. I have built the Northern Field Station in Winterhold, I should now return to Marassi to let him know.

Marassi is ready to get underway on establishing another field station. This time in the Reach. As I have other things to attend to, I have given him 2000 gold in order to build it for me. It's been a few days and I should check on the progress.

Marassi has the idea to establish a number of field stations across Skyrim to act as safehouses and supply stops for explorers. I have built the Eastern Field Station in Eastmarch. I should now return to Marassi to let him know.
The Museum has been robbed! People from Avram's shady past have made off with the contents of the museum, and now we must head to Windcaller Pass to try and locate them.

I had been tasked by Ognar to retrieve a hammer to replace his Warhammer of Inebriation, however he died before I could do that. I managed to acquire his hammer anyway. Auryen may know something more about it.
adds scales to unique dragons for displays
I should check back with the Windcaller Pass excavation and see how the things are progressing.
The excavation crew continue their dig. I should give them some more time to work and check back later or help them to clear the way.
I should give the team a few days to work on digging in the new site location, then return and see how they are doing. I can also help out with the digging to make shorter work of it.

While searching the Temple of the Divines I came across a weird looking teddy bear that appears to belong to Freir. When I picked it up a bottle of Skooma fell out of its stuffing. Perhaps I can use it as leverage to get information from her?

I have found several unusual books concerning the Dwemer but nothing that seems very useful. I should give them to Urag so he knows that this is NOT what I am looking for. Perhaps he will then have some other ideas on where to look.
Dwemer History and Culture did not have the insights I had hoped for. I should ask Urag again for more leads.

Urag finally had a clue about some books which ended up being "borrowed" by some Synod mage. His assistant Ertzebet confirmed that they had come by and were asking about Mzulft. I should check out the Dwemer ruins there to see if I can locate the misplaced books.

Brother Ikard of the order of Arkay was requested by Auryen to investigate a haunting at the museum. Not being very fond of the supernatural I left him to his own devices to solve the issue. Ikard's work should be done and I should check in to see if things have been restored to normal.
